$comment: Whether a failed attempt is retried, as every implementation of the retry predicate must answer it: the dispatcher's queue acts on the answer, and a worker reports it on job:fail as willRetry, so the two must never disagree. A retry is allowed exactly when failureClass is neither "deterministic" nor "withheld" and retryCount < maxRetries, on the record before the failure is applied (docs/protocol/JOBS.md, Retries). TypeScript (packages/typescript/sdk: willRetryAfter), Rust (packages/rust/sdk: will_retry_after, which the dispatcher uses), Python (packages/python/sdk: will_retry_after) and Go (packages/go/sdk: WillRetryAfter) run every case and fail on any difference. `failureClass` absent means the failure was not classified. Add a case here before changing an implementation.

cases.why: a transient failure with budget left
an unclassified failure is treated as transient
an unclassified failure with the budget spent
a deterministic failure, whatever budget is left: the same request cannot succeed a second time
an answer the provider withheld, whatever budget is left: the same request is withheld again
a withheld answer after an earlier retry, with budget still left
no retries were ever budgeted (a generation job)
budget left after an earlier retry
